regions.description: One layout tree per region. A region the package does not define keeps the app's own look.

greeting.description: The home screen's hero and the empty-chat screen.

sidebarHeader.description: Between the sidebar's brand row and its nav.

sidebarFooter.description: The strip above the account row at the bottom of the sidebar.

node.description: A layout node: a container of other nodes, or a component.

container.description: Lays its children out in a row, a column, a grid, or stacked on top of each other.

direction.description: stack puts every child in the same cell, layered.

gridTemplate.description: grid-template-columns, e.g. "repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))". Only with direction: grid.

component.description: Places a component: app:<key> (the app's own), primitive:<key> (building blocks) or custom:<name> (from components.json).

anyOf.description: The built-in greeting block: brand mark, title and hint.
The greeting title ("Good morning, …" on the home screen).
The line under the greeting title.
The app's brand mark (or the skin's brand.mark from sidebar.json).
The running app version.
Today's date in the UI language.
A composite defined in components.json.

props.description: Text, numbers and true/false only. Keys that name a handler or a sink (on…, style, href, …) are refused.

visibleWhen.description: One comparison: state.theme === 'dark', state.count > 3, state.desktop, !state.toolsReady. No &&, ||, or calls.

flex.description: flex-grow within a row or column.
